operation: Packaging existing artifacts only; no training, generation, metric computation or research code changes.
package_commit_note: This manifest records the exact existing code commit. The commit containing this manifest is obtained from git log -- artifacts/followup-transfer; its own hash cannot be embedded in itself.

normalization.units: Dimensionless, history-normalized coordinates for generated, ensemble, targets and histories.
normalization.formula: mu=mean(raw_history); s=std(raw_history, ddof=0); scale=s if s>0.01 else 1. history=(raw_history-mu)/scale; target=(raw_target-mu)/scale.
normalization.inference_dtype: The original inference used float32; saved generated/ensemble remain float32. Saved targets/history remain float64.
normalization.inverse_transform: Raw per-window mu/scale are not saved in the selected sample/test fields and are not reconstructed. The package supports the original normalized-coordinate forecasts. Returning to raw units would require those original per-window statistics.
normalization.model_transform: CoordinateModel q and scale buffers are contained in every checkpoint state_dict; these 24 selected models use identity q and unit scale. No external learned transform is required.

row_alignment.generated: generated[i] matches shared path_target[i] and path_history[i], for zero-based i=0..1023.
row_alignment.ensemble: ensemble[i,j] matches shared ensemble_target[i] and path_history[i], i=0..255, j=0..31. ensemble_target is exactly path_target[:256]. Ensemble history is path_history[:256], stored only once.
row_alignment.independence: generated[i] is a separate existing single-path draw; it is not asserted to equal ensemble[i,0].
row_alignment.cross_model: Within a data_seed/family, all four selected models use the same test-row order and common targets/history; no cross-data_seed alignment is implied.
